Apple’s economic moat rests on three interlocking pillars: ecosystem switching costs, privacy/brand positioning, and capital allocation discipline. iOS users exhibit the highest retention rates in consumer tech (80–85% after 12 months), driven by seamless continuity between devices, iMessage/FaceTime network effects, and deep integration of hardware/software/services [6].
